message: Hi Alex, it's Chloe at Rapid Plumbing, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hi Chloe, honest answer: I used AI to help draft it, but I wrote and reviewed it myself before sending. I also use AI for the site audits, but I check every finding by hand. The offer's real: $900 one-time fix pack for issues found, optional $250/month care plan after. Happy to show you the audit if you want to talk.
